metadata.title: Cloud Telemetry API Gateway Component Definition

components.title: TelemetryApiGateway
components.description: Mutual-TLS ingress proxy enforcing JWT bearer token validation and per-tenant rate limiting.

control-implementations.description: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 API security controls.

implemented-requirements.description: Role-based access control policy evaluated on every REST and gRPC request.
Ingress firewall terminates TLS 1.3 and restricts egress to approved telemetry sinks.
